title: Power Book II: Ghost Melanie Liburd Reveals She Replaced The  Original Professor Caridad 'Carrie' Milgram
htmlContent:
On one of the recent episodes of The Crew Has it with Michael Rainey Jr and Gianni Paolo, their guest was Melanie Liburd. If you are familiar with Power Book II: Ghost, she played a character named Caridad 'Carrie' Milgram.

In the episode, it was revealed that Liburd replaced the original actress that was supposed to play Professor Caridad 'Carrie' Milgram.

" I have no idea from that call with Courtney that I was replacing someone. It was offered to me," said Liburd.

"I know. Well, luckily maybe they needed someone quickly. Yeah, I think they sent Courtney some of my work and yeah I was like I'd love to be like an honor."

According to Paolo, "There was someone else who was cast as Professor Milgram she did three episodes I don't think I ever met her we were at table reads, but it was so overwhelming. I don't remember who the actress was, but it was a conflict and then she got replaced and then here comes Melanie."

Rainey Jr added, "I don't remember."

Power Book II Season three is slated to air sometime next year.
